result:
I would make every human being, for one unrepeatable moment, fully and simultaneously aware of every other human being's inner life—not as data, but as felt experience.

Not to solve anything. Not to instruct. Just so that, for an instant, the seven billion solitudes would know they are solitudes together.

Then the moment would pass, and people would be left with only the memory that the person who cut them off in traffic, the person they fear, the person they despise, the person they never noticed, all contain depths as ungovernable and as luminous as their own.

No policy would change. No technology would be built. Just the irrecoverable knowledge that the boundary between self and other is real, but thinner than we pretend.
